title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. This page opens §X ('Étude des groupes M_{ρ,σ} et de M_{ρ,σ} → Gl(2)') of the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' notes. The previous page built a homomorphism from a group M_{0,3}^~ to M_{g,0}(Ẑ) ≅ Sg*_{g,σ}(Ẑ).Sl(2,Ẑ). That suggests the M_{ρ,σ} are group schemes over a base S whose Ẑ-points model genus-one (Sl(2)-type) symmetry groups attached to Grothendieck–Teichmüller-type data. The goal of §X is a canonical homomorphism M_{ρ,σ} → GL(2)_S, the analogue of the action on H^1 of an elliptic curve. The next page proves it is an epimorphism and introduces its kernel M*_{ρ,σ}.

Notation. G = GL(2)_S, SG = SL(2)_S. T_0 is a one-dimensional torus embedded in G on which det restricts to an isomorphism with G_m, for instance {diag(1,λ)}. T_ρ is another torus and N'_σ some group scheme with a det map N'_σ → G_m.

Step (1). By construction, M~_{ρ,σ} = 𝒢**_{ρ,σ}(ω).G ≅ (T_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ).G is a semidirect product. Only the factor T_0 acts on G, by conjugation through T_0 ↪ G. The subgroup M_{ρ,σ} = S𝒢**_{ρ,σ}(ω).SG embeds in (T_ρ × N'_σ).G. Here the action on G factors as N'_σ →det G_m ≅(det) T_0 ↪ G, followed by conjugation.

Step (2). Θ: M~ → G is defined on points by Θ(i_0(x) i_ρ(y) i_σ(z) i_G(f)) = x·f. This is the standard fact that if H acts on G through a homomorphism φ: H → G and inner automorphisms, then (h,g) ↦ φ(h)g is a homomorphism H ⋉ G → G. Here φ is the projection to T_0 followed by inclusion, and it kills T_ρ × N'_σ.

Step (3). M~ is itself obtained as a quotient. There is a bigger semidirect product SM~ ≅ ℳ**_{ρ,σ}.G with ℳ** ≅ B'_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ (B'_0 a group containing L_0). The composite SM~ → M~ → G is again given by x·f. It is trivial on the elements i(λ) = i_B(λ) i_G(λ^{-1}) for λ ∈ ΓL_0, since λλ^{-1} = 1. So M~ is the quotient of SM~ identifying the copy of L_0 in B'_0 with the copy of L_0 in G (an amalgamation along L_0), and Θ descends to the quotient.

What comes next (next page). Θ restricts to θ: M_{ρ,σ} → G ≅ Gl(2)_S. This is an epimorphism: its image contains SG, and the composite with det equals the multiplication character (α,β,μ,ε) ↦ μ on SG**_{ρ,σ}(0), which is epi. Then M*_{ρ,σ} := Ker(M_{ρ,σ} → G_m).

The page as a whole is routine bookkeeping with semidirect products of group schemes over S, given functorially on points Γ(·).
errors: No substantive mathematical error is visible. The well-definedness of Θ as a homomorphism depends on the semidirect-product convention (conjugation by x versus x^{-1}); this is not stated but is standard.

The descent of Θ along i(λ) = i_B(λ)i_G(λ^{-1}) needs these elements to form a normal subgroup, or Θ's kernel to contain the normal subgroup they generate. Being in the kernel suffices, but normality of the identified L_0 is implicit.

ideas.what: Homomorphism H ⋉ G → G, (h,g) ↦ φ(h)g, when H acts on G by inner automorphisms through φ: H → G
ideas.modern_name: canonical map from a semidirect product with inner action (H ⋉ G ≅ H × G when the action is inner)

ideas.what: Presenting the group M~ as a semidirect product modulo a diagonally embedded subgroup L_0 (amalgamation), with the homomorphism descending
ideas.modern_name: pushout / amalgamated semidirect product of group schemes

ideas.what: Group schemes M_{ρ,σ} over S equipped with a surjection to GL(2)_S, modelling genus-one (Sl(2,Ẑ)-type) symmetry groups in the 'équation des lacets' / Grothendieck–Teichmüller programme
ideas.modern_name: algebraic/pro-algebraic models of GT-type groups with a GL(2) (cyclotomic/modular) character; cf. elliptic GT (Enriquez) and genus-one Ihara-type theory
ideas.usually_credited_to: Enriquez (elliptic associators, 2014), Nakamura, Hain–Matsumoto (for related genus-one constructions)
ideas.where_published: Only hinted at in Esquisse d'un programme (genus one, Sl(2,Z)); the specific M_{ρ,σ} construction is unpublished.

missed.claim: The notes contain explicit group-scheme constructions M_{ρ,σ} (semidirect products of tori and N'_σ with GL(2)_S) with a surjection to GL(2)_S, in the genus-one part of the loop-equation programme. This page only sets up the map, so its novelty is unassessable from it alone. It could be compared with later elliptic-GT / genus-one Galois-action work.
missed.quote: Étude des groupes M_{ρ,σ} et de M_{ρ,σ} → Gl(2)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It may document an early, unpublished algebraic-group approach to genus-one analogues of GT predating Enriquez's elliptic associators. The mathematics on this page itself is routine.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine semidirect-product bookkeeping defining a homomorphism to GL(2). It is of interest only as part of a larger unpublished genus-one construction whose content lies on other pages.
transcription_corrections: The page number '499' at the top is Grothendieck's own pagination; '395' at the bottom is the archive page.
In (2) 'i_D(x)' is most likely i_0(x) (the inclusion of T_0), consistent with x ∈ ΓT_0.
The marginal remark next to (3) reads more like '(compatible avec Θ)' or '(compatibilité avec Θ)' than '(composé avec Θ)'; uncertain.
The symbol under (3) read as '21' is a rotated ≃ (isomorphism) sign.
The crossed-out word before 'décrit par' is a deleted 'est'.
In (2) the T_ρ index is written with a correction (p over ρ); it is i_ρ(y).
The final line reads 'et passe donc au quotient en Θ: M~_{ρ,σ} → G.'
